channel.title: Gaia's Secret Agents — Nature Missions & Printable Adventures
channel.description: Screen-free family nature missions, printable activities and outdoor adventures that help families connect with nature and each other.

item.title: Ocean Activities for Kids: Screen-Free Family Adventures
item.description: Turn a beach day or nature break into a shared ocean discovery. Explore screen-free ocean activities, notice marine life, listen to coastal sounds and talk about how families can protect the sea together. A nature-led adventure for curious families who want more meaningful time outdoors.

item.title: Outdoor Learning: A Bird-Watching Activity for Kids & Families
item.description: Slow down together and become nature detectives. Observe birds from a respectful distance, notice colour, movement and calls, then share what each person discovers. This low-prep, screen-free outdoor family activity builds curiosity and connection with the natural world.

item.title: Screen-Free Family Activities: Printable Secret Agent Starter Kit
item.description: A$19 printable nature adventure for families: a story-led 33-page Secret Agent Starter Kit with 28 Secret Meeting Cards, agent identity activities and an outdoor assignment. Print at home and explore together.

item.title: Free Printable Nature Activities for Kids: Secret Agent Mission
item.description: Looking for free printable nature activities for kids? Try a nine-page secret agent mission with a 15-minute Nature Signal Hunt, code-name wheels and an Earth Protector Promise. Parent or guardian email required.

item.title: 20-Minute Outdoor Learning Activity: Schoolyard Biodiversity Detectives
item.description: A free 20-minute outdoor learning activity for primary school: compare two safe school-ground habitats, record biodiversity clues and discuss evidence. Includes materials, timings and safety guidance.
